key.name: fps-min
key.description: Used when everything is calm (lower = lighter on the CPU)

key.name: fps-max
key.description: Used while dragging the mouse or when leaves / waves move fast

key.name: active-speed
key.description: Leaves drifting at this speed make the pond run at maximum FPS

key.name: pixel-size
key.description: Each pixel-art pixel = N screen pixels (smaller = finer but heavier)

key.name: water-opacity
key.description: Below 1 lets the original wallpaper show through

key.name: leaf-count
key.description: Small leaves drifting on the water surface

key.name: weed-count
key.description: Waterweed on the bottom

key.name: layout-seed
key.description: Same number = same pond layout every time. 0 = pick a random one on first run and remember it

key.name: time-override-enabled
key.description: Always show one specific hour (for previewing)

key.name: time-override-hour
key.description: For example 18.5 = 18:30

key.name: time-speed
key.description: 1 = real time; 600 = a whole day passes in ~2.4 minutes

key.name: celestial
key.description: When off, only the old glare is used (if enabled below)

key.name: sun-size
key.description: Longest side of the image as a fraction of the screen width

key.name: moon-size
key.description: Same as above, for the moon

key.name: celestial-on-top
key.description: Not darkened by the time-of-day tint; lily pads and leaves still cover it

key.name: glow-size
key.description: Diameter as a multiple of the image size

key.name: shimmer
key.description: 0 = perfectly still when there are no waves

key.name: wave-distort
key.description: Higher = the reflection breaks up more

key.name: reflect-seg
key.description: The reflection is cut into pieces this many pixels wide (smaller = finer but heavier)

key.name: moon-up-hours
key.description: Per moonrise

key.name: new-moon-hidden
key.description: Draw nothing on moonless days

key.name: moon-age-override-enabled
key.description: For previewing the phases

key.name: moon-age
key.description: 0 = new, 7.4 = first quarter, 14.8 = full, 22.1 = last quarter

key.name: flow-speed
key.description: Leaves and weeds drift with it; 0 = still water

key.name: ambient-drops
key.description: Small drops occasionally fall onto the water

key.name: glitter
key.description: Twinkling sparkles on the water surface

key.name: glare
key.description: Fallback when there are no sun / moon images

key.name: wave-damp
key.description: Higher = waves die out faster

key.name: wave-cell
key.description: 1 wave cell = N pond pixels (1 = finer but about 4x heavier)

key.name: wave-step-rate
key.description: Sets how fast waves travel

key.name: wave-c2
key.description: Must stay below 0.5 for stability

key.name: ripple-life
key.description: Seconds a ripple keeps startling the fish

key.name: click-ms
key.description: ms: releasing faster than this counts as a click

key.name: click-move
key.description: Screen px: moving farther than this is a drag, not a click

key.name: drag-wake
key.description: 0 = no wake when dragging across the water

key.name: drag-spacing
key.description: Pond px, along the drag path

key.name: debug-click
key.description: View with journalctl -f -o cat /usr/bin/gnome-shell

key.name: leaf-spawn-min
key.description: Seconds between two random leaf falls

key.name: leaf-spawn-max
key.description: Seconds

key.name: leaf-extra
key.description: How many leaves may exceed the fallen-leaf count

key.name: leaf-sink-time
key.description: Seconds from the start of sinking until reaching the bottom

key.name: leaf-drag
key.description: Higher = less sliding, stops faster

key.name: leaf-soak-wave
key.description: Higher = even small waves sink leaves quickly

key.name: leaf-soak-fish
key.summary: Soaking from fish near the surface

key.name: leaf-dry
key.description: When the water is completely calm

key.name: leaf-float-min
key.description: Seconds (a leaf soaks through and sinks after about this long)

key.name: leaf-float-max
key.description: Seconds

key.name: leaf-bed-max
key.description: Beyond this the oldest leaf fades away

key.name: leaf-bed-kick
key.summary: Fish stirring strength on the bottom
key.description: Higher = leaves get thrown farther

key.name: leaf-bed-damp
key.description: Higher = leaves stop faster

key.name: fish-bed-z
key.summary: Height at which fish still stir leaves
key.description: A fish must be this close to the bottom

key.name: fish-avoid
key.description: Multiple of body length; 0 = no avoidance

key.name: fish-act-min
key.description: Seconds

key.name: fish-act-max
key.description: Seconds

key.name: fish-turn
key.description: rad/s

key.name: fish-depth-tint
key.description: 0 = off

key.name: fish-hit
key.description: Smaller = fish may glide closer past each other

key.name: pad-gap
key.description: Multiple of the sum of the radii

key.name: pad-rest
key.description: 0 = stick together

key.name: leaf-wash
key.summary: Wave height that washes leaves off a pad

key.name: wave-push-pad
key.summary: Maximum speed waves push a pad

key.name: wave-push-leaf
key.summary: Maximum speed waves push a fallen leaf
